title: Best of Thailand & Malaysia with FREE Tickets to Golden Buddha
highlights: Discover the highlights of Thailand and Malaysia as you explore iconic cities like Pattaya, Bangkok, and Kuala Lumpur.
Marvel at Wat Pho in Bangkok, home to the majestic Reclining Buddha, which stretches 46 metres and is adorned with gold leaf.
Stand before the awe-inspiring Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur, the tallest twin structures globally, and capture unforgettable photos.
Relax on Coral Island, known for its vibrant reefs and golden sands, offering a perfect beach escape.
Admire the Golden Buddha in Bangkok, the largest solid gold statue in the world, standing 15 feet tall and displaying remarkable artistry.
overview:
About Thailand Malaysia Tour Package:
Thailand, also known to be the crown of Southeast Asia, is studded with tons of historical and cultural sites. The floating market, exotic beaches and nature parks ensure that every moment of your journey is full of new experiences. Get ready to register new memories in your memory lane by booking the Thailand Malaysia tour package that satiates the wanderlust within you by giving you a tour of this bustling country.

With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya
days.desc: Welcome to Thailand! Upon your arrival at the Suvarnabhumi Airport in Bangkok, get transferred to your hotel in Pattaya and check-in. After you relax for some time, explore the city on your own by visiting places like the beautiful Sanctuary of Truth and vibrant Lima Lima, among other attraction points. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
days.desc: Get ready for a tropical vibe with a day trip to the beautiful Coral Island. Get transferred from the hotel to BAli Hai Pier, from where you will board the boat to Coral Island. After reaching, relax on the golden sands or try fun-filled water activities like snorkelling and swimming. With the freedom to explore the island at your own pace, you can walk around the shores and admire the views of the surroundings. Later, get transferred back to the hotel from Pattaya Beach for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Bangkok
days.desc: Enjoy the change of scenery as your destination changes from the adventure capital of Thailand, Pattaya, to the official capital of Thailand, Bangkok. Check-out and get transferred from the hotel to Bangkok. Upon your arrival, check-in at the hotel and relax. Afterward, you can explore this amazing city on your own by visiting its famous attractions, like Madame Tussauds Museum, Siam Serpentarium, and others. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bangkok Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Get ready to explore Bangkok's famous attractions on a sightseeing tour. From your hotel, you will be transferred to the first stop of the day, Wat Traimit, a temple known for its Golden Buddha idol. Then, enjoy a visit to Mahaputtaram Temple, one of the most prominent landmarks in Bangkok. After that, enjoy a visit to the stunning Grand Palace, followed by a visit to Gems Gallery. Afterward, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kuala Lumpur
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, get transferred to the airport and board your flight to Kuala Lumpur (flight tickets not included). Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. You can relax for the day or explore the city on your own by visiting places like District 21 and Jalan Alor, among others. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Make the most of your time as you explore the beautiful capital city of Malaysia on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from the hotel and explore the city's iconic attractions, like the Petronas Twin Towers, Sultan Abdul Samad, and King's Palace. Also, enjoy a visit to the National Monument and Dataran Merdeka, and later get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
